title: Lazy Sunday Middle Eastern Lamb Tagine
description: A winey and velvety Middle Eastern dish featuring cranberry, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients. This pressure-cooked lamb tagine is a hearty and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cranberry juice, red wine, dried cranberries, cumin, and turmeric.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and set the valve to sealing.
Cook on high pressure for 30 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
